fields.help_zh: 在此时间之前创建的节点池，以所在地域的时间转化为（中国内地为东八区）Unix时间戳

parameters.help_en: The filter conditions for querying resource pools
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10

items.description_en: The details of a resource pool
items.description_zh: 列表中单个资源池信息

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource pool was created

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the resource pool is the default pool. Valid values:

true: The resource pool is the default pool.

false: The resource pool is not the default pool
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否是默认资源池。取值说明：

true：是
false：否

MaxExecutorNum.description_en: The number of running executor nodes in the resource pool
MaxExecutorNum.description_zh: 在一个资源池内正在运行的执行节点用量

PoolName.description_en:
The name of the resource pool.

Maximum length: 15 characters.

Allowed characters: digits, letters, underscores (_), and periods (.)
PoolName.description_zh:
资源池名称。
长度不超过15个字符。
可包含数字、大写字母、小写字母、下划线（_）和点（.）

Priority.description_en:
The priority of the resource pool.

Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 1 (lowest priority).

Jobs in a resource pool with a higher priority are scheduled before those in a pool with a lower priority. The pool's priority overrides the priority of an individual job
Priority.description_zh:
资源池的优先级。

优先级可设置范围：1~99。默认值为1，即最低优先级。
提交到具有较高优先级层级值的资源池的作业将在较低优先级层级值的资源池中的挂起作业之前进行调度，资源池的优先级层级优先于作业的优先级

SchedulingPolicyId.description_en: The ID of the scheduling policy

Status.description_en:
The status of the resource pool. Valid values:

Creating: The resource pool is being created.

Updating: The resource pool is being updated.

Deleting: The resource pool is being deleted.

Working: The resource pool is operational.

Deleted: The resource pool has been deleted
Status.description_zh:
资源池状态。取值范围：

Creating：资源池创建中
Updating：资源池更新中
Deleting：资源池删除中
Working：资源池工作中
Deleted：资源池删除完成

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the resource pool was last updated
